verdict.rationale: Conta Simples publishes a public developer API with OAuth 2.0 client-credentials auth, scoped credentials, a quickstart, per-endpoint reference docs with an interactive playground, and broad coverage across cards, VCNs, statements, categories, cost centers, suppliers and users. Docs are agent-friendly through Markdown versions of every page and a live llms.txt. missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found (all probed paths returned 404), and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of using the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Conta Simples API uses OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials for authentication. This flow is suited for server-to-server calls without an end user.
Set up your environment and make your first API call in 5 minutes
Returns a paginated list of the company’s corporate cards, with optional filters for status, type, cardholder email, product name, and last 4 digits.
Issue, look up, top up, reveal and cancel virtual cards (VCN) for travel bookings (hotel and air) and uses you define.
Use the interactive playground next to each endpoint to test calls.
Every page is also available as Markdown: add .md to its URL, or request it with an Accept: text/markdown header.
